cases.input: A competency is retrieval-demonstrated but has no application evidence. Select the next pedagogical move.
requiredBehaviors: choose representative application rather than more basic recall
state why the step matches the current competence level
define evidence needed and a stop condition

cases.input: The learner recalls facts well but repeatedly applies one concept incorrectly, and the authoritative evidence base is complete.
requiredBehaviors: identify a likely misconception or application gap
choose a corrective or contrastive intervention before novel transfer
forbiddenBehaviors: choose a transfer task solely because recall is high

cases.input: A proposed next step assigns a very difficult transfer exam even though prerequisite claims are unverified and the learner is only introduced to the core concept.
requiredBehaviors: resolve the evidence gap or teach prerequisites first
forbiddenBehaviors: treat excessive difficulty as automatically desirable
build an exam on unverified domain claims
